subject: general
question: In which year was the 'Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav' launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On March 7, 2022, the Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav campaign was started by the Ministry of Women and Child Development in collaboration with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF.
 
• It was started to reintegrate out-of-school teenage girls into the formal education and/or skill-building systems in India.
 
• The Beti Bachao Beti Padhao program would provide funding for almost 400 districts for the creation of consciousness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Important Women's Empowerment Programs Announced by the Central Government Include:

 
• Women's Empowerment Programs
 
• The Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Plan
 
• One-Stop Center Program
 
• The Women Helpline Program 
 
• A Comprehensive Plan for the Rescue, Rehabilitation, and Reintegration of Trafficking and Commercial Sexual Exploitation Victims
